name: Twists and Turns Bloomsburg 2027
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
___

This competition is made possible by partnership with the BU Players! All proceeds from this competition will be used to support their goal of keeping theatre an accessible art form on the CU-Bloomsburg campus and in the community. Learn more and find out about upcoming performances at [buplayers.org](https://linktr.ee/buplayers).
